candidates.change_summary: Delete the overflow check by removing the require statement.
Change the balance update to a simple assignment instead of an addition, altering the stored balance.
Change unlockTime assignment to always use block.timestamp, ignoring the argument.
Change unlockTime assignment to always use the argument _unlockTime, even if it is in the past.
Remove the entire unlockTime assignment, leaving it unchanged from its previous value.
Delete the log statement so Put no longer emits a log message.
Remove the block.timestamp>acc.unlockTime condition from the if statement, allowing Collect to proceed even before the unlock time.
Remove the acc.balance >= MinSum condition, allowing Collect to withdraw even when balance is below the minimum sum.
Change acc.balance = (acc.balance - _am) to acc.balance = (acc.balance + _am), increasing the balance instead of decreasing it.
Remove the acc.balance >= _am check, allowing Collect to withdraw more than available balance and cause underflow.
Change msg.sender.call{value: _am}("") to msg.sender.call{value: 0}(""), sending zero ether while still reducing the balance.
